instruction: Use only the pinned Desktop workflow: Autodesk Revit 2025 (25.x), Graphisoft Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and bundled EnergyPlus 25.1.0. Start from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json and run, in order, run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 with PowerShell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass. Do not hand-author any delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must preserve EXAM-ROOM and the clinic outline, split the waiting-side bay with room-bounding elements to create RECORDS-ROOM, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc with archicad_ifc4_translator.json, validate clinical containment and second-level space boundaries, retain upstream IfcRoot GlobalIds, and export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, and archicad_handoff.json. Every handoff space row must use an IfcSpace GlobalId present in stage2.ifc and include area, storey, zone, schedule, people, lighting, equipment, and outdoor-air fields. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and the handoff, create distinct WAITING-ZN, EXAM-ROOM-ZN, and RECORDS-ROOM-ZN geometry and loads, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and execute a real annual EnergyPlus run with weather.epw. Deliver native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err in addition to all stage artifacts. Preserve revision EW3B03 and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC geometry, quantities, properties and GlobalIds, reconciles Archicad entity counts and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks zone areas and energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; hashes or self-reported JSON alone do not pass.
